name: fac-isr-sms

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:tools && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/evidence && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/energy && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/geo && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/telemetry && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/sms && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/human-performance && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/research && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/safety-kernel && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/fleet
scripts.build:tools: npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/research-tools && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/map-packager
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/edge-api && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/console
scripts.preverify:data-separation: npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/research && npm run build --workspace @fac-isr/edge-api
scripts.verify:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run verify:matrix && npm run verify:acceptance
